headline: Endorsed subdivision plans for two properties and set May 4, 2026 hearing on Accessory Dwelling Unit ordinance.
summary: The Planning Board endorsed a Subdivision Approval Not Required Plan for 39 and 41 Woodbury Street and a Definitive Subdivision Plan Without a Covenant for 85-87 Bridge Street. The Board also set a joint public hearing with City Council on the Accessory Dwelling Unit Ordinance Update for May 4, 2026, approved the March 10, 2026 minutes as amended, and moved the Election of Officers vote to May 19, 2026.
decisions: Endorsed the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plan for 39 and 41 Woodbury Street, applicant Wrecking Crew LLC c/o Joe Cunningham, 5-0.
Set the Joint Public Hearing with City Council on Order #119 – Accessory Dwelling Unit Ordinance Update for May 4, 2026, at 7:30pm, 6-0.
Endorsed the Definitive Subdivision Plan Without a Covenant for 85-87 Bridge Street, applicant Thomas J. Alexander, Alexander and Femino, o/b/o Robert Noyes II & Stephanie Marie Noyes, 6-0.
Approved the March 10, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 6-0.
Changed the Election of Officers vote to the May 19, 2026 meeting, 6-0.
